title: Why You Need the Growth Mindset of a Weed | Stephen Nobles | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】為什麼你需要雜草的成長心態|史蒂芬諾布林斯 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Whitney Pennington Rodgers: In your work as an educator, curiosity plays a very interesting role.
cues.en: Whitney Pennington Rodgers: In your work as an educator, curiosity plays a very interesting role.
cues.zh: 惠特尼·彭寧頓·羅傑斯：在您作為教育工作者的工作中，好奇心扮演著非常有趣的角色。

cues.text: Can you talk a little bit about how curiosity shows up in the work that you do?
cues.en: Can you talk a little bit about how curiosity shows up in the work that you do?
cues.zh: 您能談談好奇心是如何在您所做的工作中表現出來的嗎？

cues.text: Stephen Nobles: So in the work that we do, it's important for curiosity to be there.
cues.en: Stephen Nobles: So in the work that we do, it's important for curiosity to be there.
cues.zh: Stephen Nobles：所以在我們所做的工作中，保持好奇心很重要。

cues.text: It gives us the opportunity to see things not just how they are, but how they can be.
cues.en: It gives us the opportunity to see things not just how they are, but how they can be.
cues.zh: 它讓我們有機會不僅看到事物的本來面目，而且看到它們可以成為什麼樣子。

cues.text: And we're learning, in our district, that with curiosity, when students feel seen,
cues.en: And we're learning, in our district, that with curiosity, when students feel seen,
cues.zh: 我們在我們的學區中瞭解到，帶著好奇心，當學生感到被看見時，

cues.text: once they feel heard, once they feel empowered, they'll engage, they'll connect to the work,
cues.en: once they feel heard, once they feel empowered, they'll engage, they'll connect to the work,
cues.zh: 一旦他們感到被傾聽，一旦他們感到被賦予權力，他們就會參與其中，他們就會與工作聯絡起來，

cues.text: and then the attendance shows up and then the performance follows the attendance.
cues.en: and then the attendance shows up and then the performance follows the attendance.
cues.zh: 然後出現出席人數，然後表演跟隨出席人數。

cues.text: So it requires us to follow, like the great 21st-century English philosopher Ted Lasso puts it,
cues.en: So it requires us to follow, like the great 21st-century English philosopher Ted Lasso puts it,
cues.zh: 所以它要求我們遵循，就像 21 世紀偉大的英國哲學家泰德·拉索 (Ted Lasso) 所說的那樣：

cues.text: to be curious and not judgmental.
cues.en: to be curious and not judgmental.
cues.zh: 保持好奇心而不是評判性。

cues.text: And in our district, our work requires us to not be judgmental.
cues.en: And in our district, our work requires us to not be judgmental.
cues.zh: 在我們的地區，我們的工作要求我們不要做出評判。

cues.text: WPR: And can you talk a little bit about the bridge between curiosity and courage?
cues.en: WPR: And can you talk a little bit about the bridge between curiosity and courage?
cues.zh: WPR：您能談談好奇心和勇氣之間的橋樑嗎？

cues.text: How do you help people move past, I guess, what might be the fear of failure to really engage with curiosity?
cues.en: How do you help people move past, I guess, what might be the fear of failure to really engage with curiosity?
cues.zh: 我想，你如何幫助人們克服無法真正激發好奇心的恐懼？

cues.text: SN: If you get curiosity right, it's the bridge between our differences.
cues.en: SN: If you get curiosity right, it's the bridge between our differences.
cues.zh: SN：如果你的好奇心是正確的，那麼它就是我們之間差異的橋樑。

cues.text: It turns it into dialogue.
cues.en: It turns it into dialogue.
cues.zh: 它把它變成了對話。

cues.text: So you want to be able to see kids and meet them where they are,
cues.en: So you want to be able to see kids and meet them where they are,
cues.zh: 所以你希望能夠見到孩子並在他們所在的地方見到他們，

cues.text: but that requires you to see them with a lens of expectation and opportunity
cues.en: but that requires you to see them with a lens of expectation and opportunity
cues.zh: 但這需要你用期望和機會的眼光來看待他們

cues.text: without the judgment.
cues.en: without the judgment.
cues.zh: 沒有判斷力。

cues.text: And for us, one of the things that's important, that I'm always pushing my colleagues to see,
cues.en: And for us, one of the things that's important, that I'm always pushing my colleagues to see,
cues.zh: 對我們來說，最重要的事情之一就是我一直敦促我的同事看到，

cues.text: is that we have to see students beyond the data.
cues.en: is that we have to see students beyond the data.
cues.zh: 是我們必須超越資料來看學生。

cues.text: A fact with that is if a kid lives in poverty, they're not poor.
cues.en: A fact with that is if a kid lives in poverty, they're not poor.
cues.zh: 事實是，如果一個孩子生活在貧困中，他們並不貧窮。

cues.text: Their parents are poor and they live with them.
cues.en: Their parents are poor and they live with them.
cues.zh: 他們的父母很窮，他們和他們住在一起。

cues.text: The same way, if a kid's parents are rich, they're not rich.
cues.en: The same way, if a kid's parents are rich, they're not rich.
cues.zh: 同樣的道理，如果孩子的父母很富有，他們並不富有。

cues.text: Their parents are rich and they live with them.
cues.en: Their parents are rich and they live with them.
cues.zh: 他們的父母很有錢，他們和他們住在一起。

cues.text: So with that, all of the data, all of the characteristics of poverty, place it on the parents and not the student.
cues.en: So with that, all of the data, all of the characteristics of poverty, place it on the parents and not the student.
cues.zh: 因此，所有的資料、所有的貧窮特徵都將其歸咎於父母而非學生。

cues.text: See them through the lens of what's possible, and then they usually rise to the occasion.
cues.en: See them through the lens of what's possible, and then they usually rise to the occasion.
cues.zh: 從可能性的角度來看他們，然後他們通常會應付自如。

cues.text: WPR: This moment we're living in, it's sometimes really easy for people to sort of double down on what their feelings are,
cues.en: WPR: This moment we're living in, it's sometimes really easy for people to sort of double down on what their feelings are,
cues.zh: WPR：我們活在這個時刻，有時人們很容易加倍關注自己的感受，

cues.text: to be more certain about where they stand in the world instead of asking people how they feel, what they think, to be curious.
cues.en: to be more certain about where they stand in the world instead of asking people how they feel, what they think, to be curious.
cues.zh: 更確定他們在世界上的地位，而不是詢問人們的感受、想法，從而保持好奇。

cues.text: How important do you think curiosity is as a life skill for all of us in this moment?
cues.en: How important do you think curiosity is as a life skill for all of us in this moment?
cues.zh: 您認為此時此刻，好奇心作為一種生活技能對我們所有人來說有多重要？

cues.text: SN: I think it's very important.
cues.en: SN: I think it's very important.
cues.zh: SN：我認為這非常重要。

cues.text: I can only imagine a world where we celebrate not just the answers,
cues.en: I can only imagine a world where we celebrate not just the answers,
cues.zh: 我只能想像一個我們不僅慶祝答案的世界，

cues.text: but the best questions.
cues.en: but the best questions.
cues.zh: 但最好的問題。

cues.text: Because we live in this data-driven society, if the data is right, it should propose better questions.
cues.en: Because we live in this data-driven society, if the data is right, it should propose better questions.
cues.zh: 因為我們生活在這個資料驅動的社會，如果資料正確，它應該提出更好的問題。

cues.text: It should ask us to dive in deeper.
cues.en: It should ask us to dive in deeper.
cues.zh: 它應該要求我們更深入地研究。

cues.text: And that requires genuine curiosity.
cues.en: And that requires genuine curiosity.
cues.zh: 這需要真正的好奇心。

cues.text: And curiosity, when put in the right place, builds connection.
cues.en: And curiosity, when put in the right place, builds connection.
cues.zh: 當好奇心放在正確的位置時，就會建立連結。

cues.text: Connection builds friendship and partnership.
cues.en: Connection builds friendship and partnership.
cues.zh: 連結建立友誼和夥伴關係。

cues.text: That's the bridge toward a brighter future, especially in a world where everyone is so quick to give you a certain answer
cues.en: That's the bridge toward a brighter future, especially in a world where everyone is so quick to give you a certain answer
cues.zh: 這是通往更光明未來的橋樑，尤其是在一個每個人都很快給你特定答案的世界裡

cues.text: and they just say it with such confidence.
cues.en: and they just say it with such confidence.
cues.zh: 他們說話時充滿信心。

cues.text: But curiosity is the thing that gives us humility and empathy,
cues.en: But curiosity is the thing that gives us humility and empathy,
cues.zh: 但好奇心賦予我們謙卑和同理心，

cues.text: and that's the thing that we need to move forward, not just in education, but as a world, in my humble opinion.
cues.en: and that's the thing that we need to move forward, not just in education, but as a world, in my humble opinion.
cues.zh: 以我的拙見，這就是我們需要向前推進的事情，不僅在教育方面，而且是整個世界。

cues.text: WPR: Well, you said this earlier that curiosity can turn disagreement into dialogue.
cues.en: WPR: Well, you said this earlier that curiosity can turn disagreement into dialogue.
cues.zh: WPR：嗯，您之前說過好奇心可以將分歧轉化為對話。

cues.text: Can you talk a little bit about how that's shown up in the classrooms you've been in, with students
cues.en: Can you talk a little bit about how that's shown up in the classrooms you've been in, with students
cues.zh: 可以和學生談談你在課堂上的表現嗎？

cues.text: and what you've learned about the importance of curiosity for bridging a divide?
cues.en: and what you've learned about the importance of curiosity for bridging a divide?
cues.zh: 關於好奇心對於彌合分歧的重要性，您有何瞭解？

cues.text: SN: Yeah, so a good example is we started a TED-Ed student talk program in our district.
cues.en: SN: Yeah, so a good example is we started a TED-Ed student talk program in our district.
cues.zh: SN：是的，一個很好的例子是我們在我們的學區啟動了 TED-Ed 學生演講計畫。

cues.text: We started that program at one of the middle schools, well we started at an elementary school,
cues.en: We started that program at one of the middle schools, well we started at an elementary school,
cues.zh: 我們在一所中學開始了這個專案，我們從一所小學開始，

cues.text: but last year we did it at one of our middle schools.
cues.en: but last year we did it at one of our middle schools.
cues.zh: 但去年我們在一所中學做到了這一點。

cues.text: And it's a kind of tough middle school.
cues.en: And it's a kind of tough middle school.
cues.zh: 這是一所艱苦的中學。

cues.text: So when we get into this space, I'm telling the adults, before we get in here, do not judge these kids.
cues.en: So when we get into this space, I'm telling the adults, before we get in here, do not judge these kids.
cues.zh: 因此，當我們進入這個領域時，我告訴成年人，在我們進入這裡之前，不要評判這些孩子。

cues.text: We're not going to put barriers or parameters on what they can speak on, who they are, what they can do.
cues.en: We're not going to put barriers or parameters on what they can speak on, who they are, what they can do.
cues.zh: 我們不會對他們可以發言、他們是誰、他們可以做什麼設定障礙或引數。

cues.text: Let's just give them the space to be themselves without judgment.
cues.en: Let's just give them the space to be themselves without judgment.
cues.zh: 讓我們給他們空間，讓他們不帶批判地做自己。

cues.text: So we have this student who comes up -- Jordan's, skinny jeans, dreads,
cues.en: So we have this student who comes up -- Jordan's, skinny jeans, dreads,
cues.zh: 所以我們有這個學生出現了——喬丹的緊身牛仔褲，恐懼，

cues.text: hair in his face, hoodie on, looks like he’s not engaged --
cues.en: hair in his face, hoodie on, looks like he’s not engaged --
cues.zh: 頭髮遮住臉，穿著連帽衫，看起來他還沒訂婚——

cues.text: he’s over here writing to himself, and he comes up and he’s like,
cues.en: he’s over here writing to himself, and he comes up and he’s like,
cues.zh: 他在這裡給自己寫信，然後他走過來，他說，

cues.text: “What do you want to talk about? What are you interested in speaking on?” His topic was trash in space.
cues.en: “What do you want to talk about? What are you interested in speaking on?” His topic was trash in space.
cues.zh: 「你想談什麼？你有興趣談什麼？」他的主題是太空中的垃圾。

cues.text: He was interested in discussing what would happen if the trash that's orbiting Earth,
cues.en: He was interested in discussing what would happen if the trash that's orbiting Earth,
cues.zh: 他有興趣討論如果繞地球執行的垃圾會發生什麼

cues.text: from damaged satellites and different things in space, was able to be pulled into our gravitational pull.
cues.en: from damaged satellites and different things in space, was able to be pulled into our gravitational pull.
cues.zh: 來自受損衛星和太空中不同物體的物質，能夠被我們的引力所吸引。

cues.text: What that would mean.
cues.en: What that would mean.
cues.zh: 那意味著什麼。

cues.text: No adult expected that.
cues.en: No adult expected that.
cues.zh: 沒有一個成年人預料到會這樣。

cues.text: Everyone was shocked that this kid was interested in what happens if trash is pulled into our orbit.
cues.en: Everyone was shocked that this kid was interested in what happens if trash is pulled into our orbit.
cues.zh: 每個人都感到震驚，因為這個孩子對垃圾被拉入我們的軌道會發生什麼感興趣。

cues.text: To me, we were able to have that experience by just remaining curious,
cues.en: To me, we were able to have that experience by just remaining curious,
cues.zh: 對我來說，我們只要保持好奇心就能獲得這種體驗，

cues.text: to not judge them, to not guide him, to just give him the space and then the tools to meet the standard.
cues.en: to not judge them, to not guide him, to just give him the space and then the tools to meet the standard.
cues.zh: 不要評斷他們，不要指導他，只是給他空間，然後給他達到標準的工具。

cues.text: And he met the standard.
cues.en: And he met the standard.
cues.zh: 他符合標準。

cues.text: He actually surprised us.
cues.en: He actually surprised us.
cues.zh: 他實際上讓我們感到驚訝。

cues.text: And my relationship with that kid is still growing now.
cues.en: And my relationship with that kid is still growing now.
cues.zh: 我和那個孩子的關係現在仍在發展中。

cues.text: He’s in high school now, and every time I see him he’s always ... going to lock in.
cues.en: He’s in high school now, and every time I see him he’s always ... going to lock in.
cues.zh: 他現在已經上高中了，每次我見到他，他總是…會鎖定自己。

cues.text: I can't wait to see who he becomes.
cues.en: I can't wait to see who he becomes.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待地想看看他會成為誰。

cues.text: WPR: I mean, that's interesting.
cues.en: WPR: I mean, that's interesting.
cues.zh: WPR：我的意思是，這很有趣。

cues.text: It leads to this other idea of what happens when one person is curious about someone else
cues.en: It leads to this other idea of what happens when one person is curious about someone else
cues.zh: 這導致了另一個想法：當一個人對其他人感到好奇時會發生什麼

cues.text: and sort of how that spreads in a space.
cues.en: and sort of how that spreads in a space.
cues.zh: 以及它如何在空間中傳播。

cues.text: SN: Yeah, it's contagious.
cues.en: SN: Yeah, it's contagious.
cues.zh: SN：是的，它具有傳染性。

cues.text: WPR: Can you talk a little bit about how you've seen curiosity impact other people?
cues.en: WPR: Can you talk a little bit about how you've seen curiosity impact other people?
cues.zh: WPR：您能談談您所看到的好奇心如何影響其他人嗎？

cues.text: Being curious about one person impacts other people in a space.
cues.en: Being curious about one person impacts other people in a space.
cues.zh: 對一個人感到好奇會影響空間中的其他人。

cues.text: SN: So it's kind of like the way that sports works.
cues.en: SN: So it's kind of like the way that sports works.
cues.zh: SN：所以這有點像是運動的方式。

cues.text: The students were able to see and connect to one another in a way that their home life or their grades or their behavior
cues.en: The students were able to see and connect to one another in a way that their home life or their grades or their behavior
cues.zh: 學生們能夠透過他們的家庭生活、成績或行為來看待彼此並建立聯絡。

cues.text: may not have connected them before.
cues.en: may not have connected them before.
cues.zh: 之前可能沒有連線過它們。

cues.text: But it provided a safe space for the students to be seen, a safe space for them to voice their opinion.
cues.en: But it provided a safe space for the students to be seen, a safe space for them to voice their opinion.
cues.zh: 但它為學生提供了一個安全的展示空間，一個讓他們發表意見的安全空間。

cues.text: But even to back away from the students, being at the district level,
cues.en: But even to back away from the students, being at the district level,
cues.zh: 但即使在區一級遠離學生，

cues.text: for the adults and the leaders, to have that curiosity, to move in such a way
cues.en: for the adults and the leaders, to have that curiosity, to move in such a way
cues.zh: 對成年人和領導者來說，要有好奇心，要以這樣的方式行動

cues.text: that they're not just providing the answers, they're comfortable with also recognizing that some of their growth
cues.en: that they're not just providing the answers, they're comfortable with also recognizing that some of their growth
cues.zh: 他們不僅提供答案，而且樂於認識到他們的一些成長

cues.text: is going to come from the crowd that they're leading.
cues.en: is going to come from the crowd that they're leading.
cues.zh: 將來自他們所領導的人群。

cues.text: I've just seen that begin to grow in our district.
cues.en: I've just seen that begin to grow in our district.
cues.zh: 我只是看到這種情況開始在我們地區發展。

cues.text: And now for us, we're so excited for the future because of that opportunity, that curiosity.
cues.en: And now for us, we're so excited for the future because of that opportunity, that curiosity.
cues.zh: 現在對我們來說，因為這個機會和好奇心，我們對未來感到非常興奮。

cues.text: Even in leadership it's creating for us as a district.
cues.en: Even in leadership it's creating for us as a district.
cues.zh: 即使在領導力方面，它也在為我們這個地區創造機會。

cues.text: And as individuals, to be honest.
cues.en: And as individuals, to be honest.
cues.zh: 作為個人，說實話。

cues.text: WPR: I want to talk a little bit about the work you do of sort of creating a culture around this.
cues.en: WPR: I want to talk a little bit about the work you do of sort of creating a culture around this.
cues.zh: WPR：我想談談您圍繞此建立文化所做的工作。

cues.text: And, you know, we're sort of rewarded, in education, I'm sure, but just in life, for having the answer.
cues.en: And, you know, we're sort of rewarded, in education, I'm sure, but just in life, for having the answer.
cues.zh: 而且，你知道，我確信，我們在教育方面得到了某種獎勵，但只是在生活中，因為找到了答案。

cues.text: And so, how do you create a space where people feel comfortable
cues.en: And so, how do you create a space where people feel comfortable
cues.zh: 那麼，如何創造一個讓人感覺舒適的空間

cues.text: engaging with possibilities instead of just coming right down to a solution?
cues.en: engaging with possibilities instead of just coming right down to a solution?
cues.zh: 參與可能性而不是直接找到解決方案？

cues.text: SN: Yeah, just trying to create a space where everyone is looking at things
cues.en: SN: Yeah, just trying to create a space where everyone is looking at things
cues.zh: SN：是的，只是想創造一個每個人都可以觀看事物的空間

cues.text: for where they can be and how they can be.
cues.en: for where they can be and how they can be.
cues.zh: 瞭解他們可以在哪裡以及他們可以如何。

cues.text: Because sometimes if we focus just on how they are, can be daunting.
cues.en: Because sometimes if we focus just on how they are, can be daunting.
cues.zh: 因為有時如果我們只專注在他們的本來面目，可能會令人畏懼。

cues.text: And that could be enough to make people want to quit academically and in life.
cues.en: And that could be enough to make people want to quit academically and in life.
cues.zh: 這可能足以讓人們想放棄學業和生活。

cues.text: And for me, as an educator, our goal is to get our students positioned
cues.en: And for me, as an educator, our goal is to get our students positioned
cues.zh: 對我來說，作為一名教育者，我們的目標是讓我們的學生定位

cues.text: to recognize that learning isn't just a K-12 adventure.
cues.en: to recognize that learning isn't just a K-12 adventure.
cues.zh: 認識到學習不僅僅是 K-12 的冒險。

cues.text: It's not just a phase that you're in currently.
cues.en: It's not just a phase that you're in currently.
cues.zh: 這不僅僅是你目前所處的一個階段。

cues.text: To remain curious prepares them to recognize their learning as a lifelong journey.
cues.en: To remain curious prepares them to recognize their learning as a lifelong journey.
cues.zh: 保持好奇心可以幫助他們認識到學習是一生的旅程。

cues.text: And even as adults, when we remain curious, we see things through the lens of possibility.

cues.text: So she's always, throughout my life, encouraged me to be a weed,

cues.text: to constantly grow, especially if I'm in a space where I'm not supposed to be in.

cues.text: The students are being pulled in so many directions.

cues.en: And I think for everyone sitting here, what is sort of the big takeaway
